newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's 10-month oil products demand up 7.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's 10-month oil products demand up 7.5 pct.

text.p: South Korea's oil products demand rose 7.5 percent to 578 million barrels in the first 10 months of 1996 from 537.5 million a year ago, the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy said on Friday.
This compared with a 8.6 percent growth in domestic consumption in the same period of last year.
The ministry said in a statement the oil refiners produced 586.4 million barrels of petroleum products in the first 10 months, against 529.6 million a year earlier.
Hyundai Oil Refinery Co's new 200,000 barrels-per-day (bpd) crude distillation unit (CDU) began commercial production in May, while Yukong Ltd's 200,000 bpd CDU started in October.
South Korea currently has a refining capacity of 2.22 million bpd.
